title: Tenma Saki — Abyss Of Memories〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, wanna check out this shop with everyone after practice on Saturday?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What this? “The All-White Soft Serve Stand”...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! It's only gonna be around for a limited time... And it's not just the ice cream that's supposed to be white. It's the cone too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see that. I didn't know anyone made soft serve like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But it's not just that. Does Ichi still remember?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <I saw a funny-looking cloud today and decided to send over a picture of it. Doesn't it look delicious?>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right...
It looks like soft serve ice cream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Message
rows.Line: <To be fair, it'd probably melt in your hands since the cone's also white...>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Saki
rows.Line:
Haha...
You're always such a stickler for those kinds of details, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. This looks a little like that picture I sent you when you were still in the hospital, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. I also remember you sending me a picture of a little cone of soft serve in the sky.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(She really remembered!
Hehe. That makes me so happy...!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
As for Saturday...
All four of us should be able to go since I don't think we have any shifts scheduled for work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'll invite Hona and Shiho later!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, isn't that it?
It doesn't seem all that crowded right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
Six soft serves, please!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Len, KAITO, order up!
Here are your all-white soft serves!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Wow, you weren't kidding. They're completely white!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, they are...
You're sure that I can have one as well?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! I wouldn't have been able to come up with such a good song without your guys' help.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shall we also start digging in?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, since they're sort of starting to melt.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We went out of our way to get these, so let's commemorate it with a pic!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Bunch together? That's easier said than done when we're all holding ice cream...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's just try to be careful not to bump into each other.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just gotta stretch out my arm a bit more...! Oh, there we go!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! Ichi and KAITO blinked a little! One more time!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I seem to have a habit of doing that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know exactly how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! Can you show me what you just took later, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go again♪
Say, “Cheese!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, looks good!
Thank you all for your time♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, it's so yummy and rich...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's sweet but gentle, and very smooth.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Uh oh, Ichika...
Your ice cream's starting to melt down the side.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
My hands are going to get all sticky.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait...
Hehe. It's just like what we talked about back then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, that was about how the cone probably would've melted in our hands since it was also made of ice cream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, let's finish these before they melt away.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! The cream's becoming unbalanced because it's melting!
